svg.title: Physics-informed halfpipe skateboard animation
svg.desc: A helmeted skater crosses a halfpipe, performs alternating aerial grabs, and lands back on the transition. He accelerates downhill, loses speed uphill, and follows a ballistic trajectory while airborne.
svg.text: ENERGY ON THE RAMP · GRAVITY IN THE AIR
Idealized point-mass model: ½mv² + mgh on transition · projectile motion in air · drag neglected
